source_note: Browser ran against these source bytes immediately before the source commit. Evidence-only commit follows.
entitlement_mode: development fixture unlimited; production-negative unit tested
theme: dark only; live light theme unavailable
body_text_test: 26px body font and reduced motion; not full-browser 200 percent zoom
picking_stress: 20K case alternates all/call filter, proves same canvas remains connected, then picks; retained source identity is used.
performance_probe_scope: Prior density-cap source, before stable renderer repair. SwiftShader software renderer, not native GPU. Draw-call rate is not presentation FPS; CPU and heap are whole-page; one-second idle is not long-run leak proof. Before/after also changed competing browser load, so no single-cause improvement attribution.
native_gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2 Ultra; installed Google Chrome headed
native_probe_scope: 20K: 360 filter updates retain canvas; tracked buffers/programs remain 7/2 and 721248 buffer bytes at checkpoints; all return to zero at unmount. Three-second idle windows draw zero scene frames. Native picking <=2.9ms in sampled runs. Scripted interaction submits about35-38 scene draws/sec. RAF cadence is not compositor presentation FPS. Whole-page heap after explicit GC fluctuates and drifts from about22.6 to23.4MB during the 360-cycle sample; no claim of zero long-session growth or total VRAM measurement.
native_zoom_scope: English selection/dismissal at native200%; CSS953x602; document overflow0; separate FLOW_FIXTURE dataset from2026-07-10. See native-zoom.json. The automated26px body-text case remains a separate, narrower check.
